product.ta-alphatronic-p4.summary: The P4 gave the office Alphatronic a fixed disk alongside its floppy drive.
product.ta-alphatronic-p4.history: The P4 appeared alongside the P3 in 1982. It was the office option with fixed storage and retained CP/M supplied on floppy. In 1984 Triumph-Adler showed the 12.5 MB disk for the P4 and P40.
product.ta-alphatronic-p4.technical.conf: The fixed disk expanded storage for programs and data. The 1984 manual gives 360 tracks per surface, four surfaces and 17 sectors of 512 bytes per track.
product.ta-alphatronic-p4.technical.veri: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p4.technical.limi: The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
product.ta-alphatronic-p4.technical.sour: Es begann mit einem KISS · HNF
